title: Ana and the Lost Kitten
text:
Ana hears a small sound. Mew, mew. It comes from under the porch. Ana gets down on her knees. A tiny gray kitten looks out at her. It is scared. Its fur is wet from the rain.

"Do not be afraid," says Ana, in a soft voice. She holds out her hand. The kitten steps closer. Ana picks it up. It is so light!

Ana wraps the kitten in her scarf. She looks for a collar, but there is none. "I will search for your home," she says. Ana walks down the street and asks each neighbor. At last, a boy at the corner shouts, "That is my kitten!" He hugs it close. Ana smiles. The kitten is safe now.
